summary: Public ESP32/M5Stack firmware collection for heterogeneous telemetry, observer, UI and experimental specialist nodes with explicit protocol, recovery, protected primary missions, bounded coordinator side-work, cumulative spiral-evolution and shared genome-lineage boundaries.
implemented_scope: public firmware sketches for multiple ESP32/M5Stack nodes
source assembly for selected multi-tab sketches
CI compilation/static checks for selected public build paths
credential separation through examples/ignored local configuration
Demiurge spiral binding for persistent learning identity, failed-attempt lessons, stale-node lineage and recovery ascent
SWARM_GENOME_LEDGER joining per-entity SpiralLedgers into one append-only bidirectionally traversable genealogy
Buzz coordinator/worker distribution lineage relevant to generalized HELIOS swarm orchestration

AUTONOMOUS_SPECIALIST_DOCTRINE requiring protected primary missions, bounded side-quests, safe local autonomy, self-tested acceleration, persistent learning with flash-wear guards and continued swarm visibility
ADV_Elite architecture adoption of the generalizable Zim specialist properties without copying mining-specific lore or treating SHA rarity as intelligence
pull-request review checklist enforcing primary-mission, side-work-budget, immutable-truth, acceleration, persistence and autonomy checks
invariants: sensor truth must be distinguishable from prediction, memory and UI fiction
observer-only nodes must not increase submit pressure
adaptive work scheduling must not alter SHA-256, target math, pool difficulty or submit semantics
every upgraded node declares a protected primary mission
coordinator side-work is explicitly bounded and must not silently starve the node's specialization
new acceleration paths must prove required semantic equivalence against a trusted reference before promotion and retain a safe fallback
online learning is restricted to a bounded safe policy space around immutable truth, protocol and user-control semantics
useful local learning may persist across reboot only with versioning, throttled writes and a known-good fallback
autonomous local policy does not remove heartbeat, health, provenance or trusted swarm visibility
recovery and stale-node handling must remain inspectable
learning identities and their failed attempts must not be silently erased; bounded active windows require archive or durable summary
recovery advances lineage as a new spiral turn rather than erasing the failed turn through rollback semantics
every admitted spiral turn is indexed into the shared genome genealogy
cross-entity specialization or synthesis names explicit parent genome nodes instead of replacing them
DNA/genome language is an architecture metaphor for lineage and paired identity/evidence strands, not a biological claim

autonomous_specialist_doctrine.reference_experiment: ZimGeek autonomy and Buzz leaderboard behavior

not_claimed: precognition or access to future physical information
autonomous authority over people or external systems
retroactive cancellation of historical MIT grants
patent protection without a verified filing
